items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer and Bruce Johnstone as the interviewee. No personal interaction or relationship beyond the professional context of the interview is described.

ctx.x: Bruce was interviewed in Dunkirk, New York on October 11, 2013, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m in Fredonia, New York, actually we’re in Dunkirk, but we’re both here because of Fredonia sort of. And I’m happy to have Bruce Johnstone here, baritone sax extraordinaire and composer and arranger.
